Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Montana Avenue / 27th Street CBD core with the courthouse square, historic Skypoint, and the densest commercial permitting corridor in south-central Montana.

Midtown.name: Midtown
Midtown.description: Grand Avenue corridor between downtown and the West End with mid-century retail strips, motel conversions, and steady small-bay remodel permits.

MetraPark District.name: MetraPark District
MetraPark District.description: First Interstate Arena at MetraPark and the airport-adjacent event campus with parking-lot infill, hospitality upgrades, and big-box reuse permits.

West End.name: West End
West End.description: King Avenue / Grand Avenue growth belt with medical-office expansion (Billings Clinic West), auto-oriented retail redevelopment, and the metro's largest new-construction valuations.

Rimrock.name: Rimrock
Rimrock.description: Rimrock Mall and West Park Promenade trade area with enclosed-mall redevelopment, grocery-anchored pads, and the last infill parcels along King Ave.

South Side.name: South Side
South Side.description: Historic South Side below I-90 with the South Park greenbelt, brick bungalow stock, and affordable single-family infill along the Midland rail corridor.

Southgate.name: Southgate
Southgate.description: Southgate Drive corridor at the city's south edge with newer subdivisions, the Southgate Mall trade area, and incremental multifamily infill.

Billings Heights.name: Billings Heights
Billings Heights.description: Main Street north-of-the-river residential plateau with ranch inventory, box-retail nodes, and steady single-family and duplex permitting.

Airport District.name: Airport District
Airport District.description: Billings Logan International Airport and the surrounding aviation/logistics employment zone with hangar construction, freight expansion, and hotel permitting.

Lockwood.name: Lockwood
Lockwood.description: Unincorporated Lockwood community east of the city line with I-90-adjacent trade parcels, light-industrial expansion, and affordable-acreage home building.
